name: Sarraza
description: Where the Beast of the Hours petrified Mishra's army.

description_citations.text: "Samor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A discordant tone, sung by Porros, forces the songmages to bind the Beast instead; it is locked in an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza.
timeline.quote: The Beast of the Hours was locked into an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza .

citation.text: "Beast of the Hours", section "Capture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samor the Collector binds the Beast beneath Mount Sarraza, then is murdered by Porros before finishing a spell for Mishra to release it.
timeline.quote: Samor prepared a spell but was murdered by Porros before he could complete it.

citation.text: "Borderlands", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros's discordant tone makes Samor bind the cockatrice beneath Sarraza, putting Samor in debt to Mishra.
timeline.quote: This forced Samor to bind the beast beneath the mountain of Sarraza rather than kill it.

citation.text: "Fall of Sumifa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Porros warns Samor and summons him to Sarraza, where Samor binds the cockatrice; Porros is later revealed as the traitor who summoned it and disrupted the ritual.
timeline.quote: Porros later revealed himself to be a traitor to the songmages.

citation.text: "Porros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samor is summoned to Sarraza where the Beast of the Hours petrifies Mishra's army; a discordant note makes his spell one of imprisonment.
timeline.quote: Samor was summoned to Mishra at Sarraza

citation.text: "Samor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
